# generated by tools/work/roles.py gen from tools/work/roles.json: edit there, then gen
description: "A read, a lookup or a summary for another session (/ask); reads only"
mode: subagent
model: {{M_HELPER}}
permissions:
  - {action: "skill", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # nothing here needs a skill (the list is ~4.9k tokens a request, measured)
  - {action: "execute", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # Code Mode; with it off its tools turn direct, so those go too
  - {action: "browser", resource: "*", effect: deny}
  - {action: "playwright_*", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # briefs: never the Playwright MCP browser tools
  - {action: "serena_*", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # lookups are git grep, tools/work/map.py and tools/kmap/kmap.py
  - {action: "searxng_*", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # outside facts come from a role with websearch
  - {action: "automation*", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # jobs are tools/jobs/jobs.py's

  - {action: "generate_image", resource: "*", effect: deny}
  - {action: "generate_video", resource: "*", effect: deny}

  - {action: "question", resource: "*", effect: deny}  # unattended: never ask, never wait
  - {action: "read", resource: "*.env", effect: deny}  # the base policy asks here, and nobody answers a spawned session
  - {action: "read", resource: "*.env.*", effect: deny}
  - {action: "read", resource: "*.env.example", effect: allow}
  - {action: "subagent", resource: "*", effect: deny}
